title: Western Union Yields 15.5%, but Its Dividend Hasn’t Grown in 5 Years
summary: Western Union just paused its buybacks and walked away from a major merger, yet the payout stayed untouched. Cash flow is thinning and rivals are sprinting ahead, so how long can management keep protecting that dividend?

title: How Hy Vee Renewal At Western Union Stock Has Changed Its Investment Story
summary: Western Union announced that it renewed its long running agreement with Hy-Vee, remaining the exclusive provider of Money Transfer, Money Order and Bill Pay services across more than 270 Midwest grocery locations. The extension keeps Western Union embedded in everyday retail traffic, which may support transaction volumes while the business invests in digital and account based money movement. We will now look at how Western Union's investment narrative is affected by this Hy-Vee exclusivity...
